# Project AI Guide

> Generic instructions and discovered context for the current project.

Use the repository contents and active capability profile as the source of truth. Do not infer behavior from the repository name.

## Architecture

- languages: python, sql, terraform
- cloud: aws
- infrastructure: terraform

## Capabilities

- python (languages/language)

## Skills / Guidance

- ai/skills/data/athena_patterns.md: Athena query lifecycle, result pagination, partition pruning, partition projection, and workgroup cost guardrails
- ai/skills/python/bedrock_client.md: Bedrock invoke_model and converse patterns, throttling retry, response parsing, and context window guard
- ai/skills/data/data_contracts.md: Data validation and schema enforcement
- ai/skills/data/data_quality_guidance.md: Deterministic data quality checks for Python, SQL, and AWS workflows
- ai/skills/python/error_handling_pipeline.md: Typed exception hierarchy, Step Functions Catch integration, and structured error payloads for pipeline stages
- ai/skills/data/etl_patterns.md: ETL pipeline Bronze/Silver/Gold layers, transformations, and OCR normalisation stage with prompt versioning
- ai/skills/python/logging_structured.md: Mandatory log field contract, JSON formatter, LoggerAdapter context injection, and CloudWatch Insights queries
- ai/skills/python/python_project_guidance.md: Simple, maintainable Python automation and pipeline code
- ai/skills/python/python_testing_quality.md: Testing guidance for Python automation, data workflows, and AWS boundaries
- ai/skills/sql/sql_workflow_guidance.md: Maintainable SQL file organization and transformation workflow guidance

## Agent Onboarding

- Start with AGENTS.md for the agent contract and skill trigger map.
- ai/context.yaml is the authoritative AI context-generation config.
- ai/domains/index.md provides domain-based navigation across skills.
- .ai/ contains generated context artifacts (optional, never required at runtime).
